lifecycleRepair.rootCause: All scenes stayed mounted with hidden/inert but did not have an activation lifecycle; document workspace sessions and portal popover escaped DOM hidden ownership.
lifecycleRepair.guard: Local ActiveSessionGuard inside every E2–E6 Workspace, active=false clears temporary/ribbon via DISMISS_TEMP reason=outside and exits focus with EXIT_FOCUS; no focus restoration into hidden scene.
lifecycleRepair.portal: E1 receives active(default true); only stateless navigation subtree ScopeNavigation uses active/inactive session key. Application scope/removal/drafts remain mounted in CourseResources.
lifecycleRepair.appTestSeam: Original pure hash app moved from consumer.tsx to consumer-app.tsx to unit-test real hash transitions. Entry remains consumer.tsx with original style imports, StrictMode and createRoot; W6Consumer is reexported.
lifecycleRepair.E6Delta: Only active optional prop(default true), guard import and guard render within WorkspaceLayout. Resource/draft/save/filter/scroll business unchanged.
